notes:
Start-up screen: a GAMbit window with the logo, version, a progress bar and what it’s doing (“Loading GAMbit…”, “Building the window…”) appears as soon as it launches. It closes when the main window opens. A preview is attached.

Opening faster: the slow part was GAMbit building all of its 90-plus pages before showing anything.

It now builds only Home at launch. The other pages are built quietly a few seconds after the window appears, so opening them later is still instant.
On my test machine, building the window went from about 5 seconds to under a second. Your PC took much longer, so I can’t promise your exact time, but it should open noticeably sooner.
Scheduled jobs now skip the window code completely, so they start faster too.
